name: SOC Microsoft Purview DLP
description: Enhancements for Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention alerts (via the Microsoft Graph Security alerts feed) used by the SOC Framework on Cortex XSIAM. Reshapes DLP policy alerts from `msft_graph_security_alerts_raw` (serviceSource = dataLossPrevention) into properly-shaped XSIAM alerts with DS:Microsoft/Data Loss Prevention tags so Foundation Product Classification routes them into the DLP category.
author: Palo Alto Networks
